speaker: Villager
text: You— you're not one of them? Oh, thank the Warders. We hid when the torches came.

speaker: Villager
text: You're academy-bound, aren't you? Vael sits past the ford, up the north road. Grandest thing you'll ever see — they say the founders' wardstones still hum under its halls.

speaker: Villager
text: Take this. My son carried one in the border levy — said a fighter who won't mind their own wounds is a fighter someone else has to carry home.

speaker: Villager
text: Drive them off. Please. This village has burned enough.
